semantic.Implementation: [Worker Core identity failures](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/8da6157b77247dcbdf209ef12f491f0b92ca858a/skills/worker/core/worker/trust.ts#L17-L51) ·
semantic.Contract: Trusted loopback forwarding, exact allowed peers and valid configured Ed25519 source keys apply at their selected boundaries.
semantic.Test: No fresh wrong-peer, remote-proxy or invalid-source-key execution accompanies these implementation links.
semantic.Limit: Repair the rejecting owner and retain original identities; a retry or broader network allow does not resolve authentication failure.
